insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers need to update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should check the metafield setup before querying and handle the error accordingly. This change affects all GraphQL Admin API queries that filter by metafields, so developers should review their code and update it to comply with the new behavior. The `metafield` object and its `key` and `value` fields are affected by this change.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate results from apps that use the GraphQL Admin API, as apps will no longer return incorrect results due to misconfigured metafields.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API, which is essential for building robust and trustworthy apps. It also helps developers catch and fix errors earlier, reducing the risk of bugs and errors in their apps.

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API (shopify.printing). This enables extensions to discover and send documents to connected receipt printers.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10, instead of silently returning incorrect results.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, introducing a simpler way to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview introduces a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

recap.headline: Enhanced printing and error handling for Shopify developers

themes.title: POS UI Extensions
themes.detail: The Printing API (shopify.printing) is now available, enabling POS UI extensions to discover and print directly to hardware receipt printers using getPrinters(). This update is part of POS UI Extensions 2026-07. Developers can leverage this feature to create more seamless in-store experiences.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Improvements
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10. This change ensures that developers receive accurate feedback when querying metafields that aren't set up for filtering, rather than receiving incorrect results. Developers should review their metafield queries to ensure compatibility with this update.
